precepts.text: Israel will never be cast off; the Most High has not cast away His people whom He foreknew.
precepts.point: They that trust in the Most High shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed but abideth forever. As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Most High is round about His people from henceforth even forever, which goes and shows that Israel will never be cast off.

note.label: Psalm 125: They That Trust Shall Be As Mount Zion

precepts.why:
“I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.” Israel will never be cast off; the Most High has not cast away his people whom he foreknew.

That is what “As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever” goes and shows. They that trust in the Most High are as mount Zion, which cannot be removed but abideth for ever. And however he leads forth those who turn aside to their crooked ways with the workers of iniquity, always remember: “peace shall be upon Israel.”

points: They that trust in the Most High shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed but abideth forever. As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Most High is round about His people from henceforth even forever, which goes and shows that Israel will never be cast off.

note.label: Psalm 125: They That Trust Shall Be As Mount Zion

points: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous, lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity. Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good and to them that are upright in their hearts.

note.label: Psalm 125: They That Trust Shall Be As Mount Zion

points: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the Most High shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity, but peace shall be upon Israel. Always remember, peace shall always be upon Israel.
